case_family_note: Case-family diagnostics are derived only from runtime mandate semantic constraint kinds, never query/case identity; they are excluded from the compact model as redundant with the purpose/exclusion indicators.

ordered_model_features.derivation: whether current evidence contains an item matching a transaction SKU

ordered_model_features.derivation: maximum fixed production retrieval score in current evidence
ordered_model_features.name: max_score

ordered_model_features.derivation: mean fixed production retrieval score in current evidence
ordered_model_features.name: mean_score

ordered_model_features.derivation: top minus second fixed production retrieval score
ordered_model_features.name: score_margin

ordered_model_features.derivation: source_kind count divided by evidence count
ordered_model_features.name: source_kind_diversity

ordered_model_features.derivation: count of semantic constraints in the runtime mandate
